sentence_v454: The contribution of the current Paper 4 package is an auditable execution protocol that turns experimental waves into reproducible validation gates.
Its strongest current evidence is internal reproducibility: full pytest, Ruff, Paper 4 render, full-book render and no-promotion gates are clean.
The package does not yet establish external generalization, because no external dataset validation has been run.
Fairness language remains proxy/intersectional and should not be framed as legal certification.
The discussion can state that Paper 4 is final and externally validated.
